Deck Name : Red Trophies of Death
Author : Norman S. Brown Jr
Description :

through combat or sunrise service) and diablerize him withe one of you
other Red Listers to get trophies on them. You then play Rebirth to
protect your Red List vampires. Other assorted tricks are
Trophy:Chosen and Shakar, Vast Wealth and Trophy:Wealth,

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
This Deck Idea does not work. Diaberizing your own Red Listed Minoin
is neither in Combat or as the result of a D action. See the Rules
Quote below.

Trophy:

Trophy is a new type of master card. A trophy may be put into play
using a master phase action (or can be retrieved as listed under "Red
List"). It has no effect until it is moved to a vampire.

When any vampire burns a Red List minion in combat or as a (D) action
(including diablerie), the controller of the trophy may choose to move
the trophy to that vampire. Any number of trophies in play may be
moved
to the vampire in this way. Once placed on a vampire, a trophy cannot
be moved again.
